International Cheese Federation Blog Archive - September 2019
This page from the International Cheese Federation website presents an archive of blog posts from September 2019. It features a member spotlight on a retail member building a cheese destination, an educational piece on the timing of blue cheese piercing, and industry news regarding wholesale cheese prices and export trends. The page also includes general site navigation, categories, recent posts, and tags related to the cheese industry.

Yuri Lee 




 


Four years building a case, one supplier at a time 

 

One retail member has spent four years turning a single cheese counter into a destination case, and most of that work happened one small producer relationship at a time.

The vein you can’t rush 

 

Blue cheese looks like a mold problem you’re managing on purpose, but the timing of the piercing is what actually decides whether the veins turn out even.

Industry News 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


Cheese crosses two dollars, and the case still can’t keep up 

 

Wholesale cheese has cleared two dollars a pound for the first time in years, and members are asking whether the tighter export picture will hold through the holidays.
